definitions.explanation: An image, film, or design rendered only in shades of black and white, without color. Abbreviation of モノクローム.

examples.japanese: モノクロの{写真|しゃしん}が{好|す}きだ。
モノクロで{撮影|さつえい}した。
examples.english: I shot it in black and white.

examples.japanese: {古|ふる}いモノクロ{映画|えいが}には{独特|どくとく}の{味|あじ}わいがある。
examples.english: Old black-and-white movies have a unique charm.

notes:
モノクロ is an abbreviation of モノクローム (monochrome). It is the standard casual term for black-and-white imagery.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- モノクロ{写真|しゃしん}: black-and-white photo
- モノクロ{映画|えいが}: black-and-white film
- モノクロで{撮|と}る: to shoot in black and white
- モノクロ{印刷|いんさつ}: monochrome printing

モノクロ VS {白黒|しろくろ}:
{白黒|しろくろ} is the native Japanese term for black and white. Both are commonly used, but モノクロ sounds more artistic or technical, while {白黒|しろくろ} is more colloquial.
